name: Don't Steal the Country 🌍
desc:
🎉 Welcome to Don’t Steal the Country!

🤫 Be quiet… don’t wake the Security!
😴 Sneak in and grab Countries while they sleep!
🏃 Run fast before they wake up and chase you!
⚡ Collect as many Countries as you can!
💪 Upgrade your character to get even more money!

💸 Your Countries make cash even when you’re offline! 💤

✅ LIKE the Game and JOIN the Group for a FREE cash bonus! 👍
